In order to assemble the circuit, you start by connecting a wire to the MOSFET. Next you connect the middle pin of the MOSFET to the resistor and the other end of the resistor to the middle pin of the potentiometer. The other pins of the potentiometer can be connected to wires. One will be connected to the MOSFET and the other to the pin will be used to attach the power supply and the multimeter. When all of those connections are made the multimeter will be able to read the voltage going across the circuit. Finally, you can attach the DC motor to the circuit, and it will start spinning due to the correct assembly of the circuit.
